derivation: or תִּמָרָה; from the same as H8558 (תָּמָר);

occurrences.text: Who is this that cometh out of the wilderness like pillars of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, with all powders of the merchant?
And I will shew wonders in the heavens and in the earth, blood, and fire, and pillars of smoke.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
